title: RefGauge: reference-aware transport auditing and selective reference standardization for cross-study omics

creators.name: Syed, Sabih ur Rehman
creators.affiliation: Department of Biology, College of Science, United Arab Emirates University, Al Ain, United Arab Emirates

description:
RefGauge audits how much a cross-study effect estimate depends on the reference population that defines the contrast, and reports held-out transport separately from reference sensitivity.

Version 0.3.0 adds a finite-reference-family excess-discrepancy estimand calibrated against direct primary-primary disagreement on the same metric, hierarchical equal-source weighting with leave-one-primary-source diagnostics, and joint source-bootstrap confidence limits that retain shared target and reference dependence. Strict direct-design, independence, covariance, reference-stability and protocol-transport gates decide identifiability before any scalar is emitted; when the quantity is not identified the tool returns a machine-readable abstention state and retains all descriptive diagnostics rather than reporting a score. The v0.2 descriptive reference audit and held-out transport behaviour are preserved unchanged.

RefGauge does not select a biologically correct reference, and it does not produce a universal fidelity score.
